title.footer: All names and teams are fictional. Placeholder art.
about.title: About Alpha 0.2
about.included.b: One full single-player season: pick a club, set your lineup, set each player's training, draft heroes against the clock, set your game plan, watch the match feed, read the report. 10 clubs, 18 league rounds, then a top-4 playoff (semi-finals best of 3, final best of 5). Players grow with training and tire from playing; veterans decline over the years. Your progress saves automatically.
about.test.b: New in this build: Game plan (after the draft) and Training (club office). Does the game plan feel like a real choice, and do you understand what each setting does? Does training feel worth the attention, and is fatigue clear enough to know when to rest players? Is a game still quick (about 5 minutes with the draft)? Anything confusing, slow or broken?
about.limits.b: Recruitment and free agents, contracts, finances, sponsors, Team Bonds, animations and art. Match results are text only. Hero and player names are placeholders.
about.report.b: Open Settings and tap Copy debug info, then paste it into your message with what you saw. Screenshots help too.

gp.title: Game plan
gp.intro: A plan moves strength between parts of the game. It helps where your team is stronger or the contest is close. Risk and aggression change how swingy the game is: they help the underdog and hurt the favourite.
gp.trigger_hint.behind_early: Used from the mid-game on if you are clearly behind after the early game.
gp.trigger_hint.ahead_early: Used from the mid-game on if you are clearly ahead after the early game.
gp.trigger_off: Off: tap to set a separate plan
gp.switch.behind_early: Early game over: you are behind, switching to your 'if behind' plan.
gp.switch.ahead_early: Early game over: you are ahead, switching to your 'if ahead' plan.
gp.switch.vs_dive: Switching to your plan against Dive.
gp.switch.vs_siege: Switching to your plan against Siege.
gp.switch.vs_protect: Switching to your plan against Protect.

gp.c.g.pos: Group up: stronger team fights, weaker lanes

gp.c.t.pos: Scale: stronger late game, weaker lanes

gp.c.m.pos: Contest them: stronger mid-game objective, weaker fight

train.title: Training
train.intro: Each player works on one thing between match days. Growth is slow and shrinks near a player's ceiling. Training adds a little fatigue, resting adds none. Starters get tired from playing, so rest them when the rating loss gets large.
train.last_none: Nothing trained yet. Play a match day first.
train.squad_h: Tap a player to change his focus
